meta.title: dsh-qgis-driver
meta.description: Drive the QGIS running on this machine (dsh_qgis_driver plugin) from DeepSeek Harness: execute code on the QGIS main thread, submit background tasks, and poll results. Instances are discovered through the plugin registry - no address or key to configure. A QGIS connection-status widget below the composer can be enabled in Settings (off by default).
